about_the_game:
Aircraft Evolution — Arcade Air Combat Action Game

Take control of a powerful aircraft in this fast-paced 2D side-scrolling arcade game. Bomb enemy bases from above using a vast arsenal of explosive weaponry!

Try the Demo:

The demo includes the first 5 missions from the early era, showcasing the game’s mechanics, unique style, combat rhythm, and gameplay variety.

Evolve Your Aircraft:

Start with basic biplanes and unlock advanced fighter jets. Each generation brings new weapons, tactics, and air combat strategies.

Diverse and Upgradeable Bomb Arsenal:

Unlock and enhance a variety of bombs — from standard and cluster bombs to liquid, electric, and even nuclear ones. Upgrade their power through research and progression systems.

Stylish 2D Graphics and Destructible Environments:

Enjoy vibrant visuals and dynamic physics-based destruction as you wage aerial warfare.

Aircraft Evolution blends explosive action with an intuitive upgrade system.
Start from early aviation, destroy enemy strongholds, and command the evolution of air combat!

short_description: Aircraft Evolution is a 2D arcade action game about aerial warfare. Pilot combat aircraft, drop bombs, and destroy enemy bases. Upgrade your planes, unlock new weapons, and experience the evolution of aviation.
